fixture_schema_source: Current app.database.Base.metadata; selected source has no migration applied by this runner
source_runtime: Uvicorn without reload; code captured before process startup
topology: 4 native web processes, one async affinity proxy, local PostgreSQL; separate lab port and schema

metrics.percentile_method: Nearest-rank over 1ms response-time buckets; requests started before or completed after the steady window excluded

resources.cpu_semantics: Process CPU sum; 100% = one logical core. Host CPU is normalized across all logical cores. RSS includes the Python launcher and its child processes.

audit_observation.limitation: Aggregate count only; timed-out requests may also commit. This is not per-operation exactly-once verification.

limitations: Generator and services share one physical host
Only the specified latency/error NFR can be assessed; this does not certify HA, authorization completeness or all write invariants
Local native database has no container resource isolation; compare like-for-like profiles and steady windows
